name: GlzUniversalSearch
semanticRole: Provide the central search, navigation, and command surface across apps, files, people, actions, settings, recent items, related semantic results, and clearly identified generated answers.

material.rule: The collapsed search entry may use Regular Glaze. Expanded dense result content moves toward Thick/Solid Glaze or Raised surfaces so text and source hierarchy remain clear.

input.keyboard: Keyboard operation follows the component's semantic role; no required action depends on pointer-only interaction.
input.focus: Focus is visible, deterministic, and restored or moved according to the component's spatial transformation.
input.hover: Hover may enrich presentation but never exposes the only path to essential information or actions.
input.press: Press feedback is immediate and does not wait for decorative animation before semantic state changes.

accessibility.role: Expose the query as searchbox/combobox semantics as appropriate, grouped results with clear labels, and deterministic command actions as named interactive controls.
accessibility.name: The search field has a stable accessible name and its current scope is programmatically available rather than encoded only in placeholder text.
accessibility.state: Expose expanded/collapsed, busy, result selection, result count/status, and generated-answer identity.
accessibility.value: The searchbox exposes the current query; selected result and preview state are programmatically determinable.
accessibility.keyboard: Ctrl/Command+K or an equivalent launcher opens the surface; focus enters immediately, arrows move results, Enter executes the primary safe result, Escape closes or steps back, and destructive actions require a second explicit step.
accessibility.focus: Opening places focus in the query without waiting for animation; closing restores the invoker; preview updates do not move focus unexpectedly.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Errors remain associated with the affected control or content and are announced without color-only meaning.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Replace palette expansion and preview spatial motion with direct state changes or short crossfades.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with an opaque surface while preserving hierarchy and boundaries.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen focus, boundaries, selected state, and text contrast without changing semantics.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system colors, visible focus, and remove decorative gradients, blur, and shadows.
accessibility.largeText: Reflow at 200% text without clipping essential labels, actions, sources, or state.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Replace palette expansion and preview spatial motion with direct state changes or short crossfades.
fallbacks.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with an opaque surface while preserving hierarchy and boundaries.
fallbacks.highContrast: Strengthen focus, boundaries, selected state, and text contrast without changing semantics.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors, visible focus, and remove decorative gradients, blur, and shadows.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur, ambient gradients, decorative shadows, and nonessential morphing before changing semantic structure, target geometry, focus, or readable contrast.

content.overflow: Result groups scroll within the bounded surface while the query remains available; long titles and context wrap/clamp without hiding category identity.
content.localization: Group labels, result titles, shortcuts, actions, and generated-answer labels tolerate 30–50% expansion.
content.rtl: Search input and results follow locale direction while shortcuts, file paths, and code-like tokens may use direction isolation as appropriate.

criteria: Deterministic Best Match and source results remain visually primary to generated interpretations.
Search opens ready for typing immediately and keyboard traversal never waits for expansion motion.
Mobile, tablet, and desktop forms preserve one search model with deliberate geometry changes.
